title: HTTP2: Get full path in notifyuri instead of referenceid
description:
Since there is no standart for notifyuri in 3gpp, looking for
referenceid in path would not work for different implementations.
Changed to get whole path from uri and add imsi accordingly to context.

Similar can be done in `dissect_3gpp_notifyuri`, regex match to imsi first and store as referenceid, else store full URI as notifyuri

HTTP2: Get full path in notifyuri instead of referenceid

Since there is no standart for notifyuri in 3gpp, looking for
referenceid in path would not work for different implementations.
Changed to get whole path from uri and add imsi accordingly to context.
Removed referenceid map and used notifyuri instead.
